description: This file defines the OptimizerNodeVisitor class, which implements AST optimization strategies for Twig templates, particularly focusing on optimizing 'for' loops and print nodes.

classes.name: OptimizerNodeVisitor
classes.description: A final class implementing NodeVisitorInterface that provides AST optimization for Twig templates, focusing on simplifying loop and print nodes based on configurable optimizer modes.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the visitor with a specified optimizer mode, validating the mode and triggering deprecations for certain modes.

methods.name: enterNode
methods.description: Processes nodes upon entering during AST traversal, applying 'for' loop optimizations if enabled.

methods.name: leaveNode
methods.description: Processes nodes upon leaving during AST traversal, applying 'for' loop optimizations and optimizing print nodes.

methods.name: optimizePrintNode
methods.description: Simplifies PrintNode instances by replacing certain expressions with TextNodes or setting output attributes.

methods.name: enterOptimizeFor
methods.description: Handles the logic for starting the optimization of 'for' nodes, managing loop state and attributes.

methods.name: leaveOptimizeFor
methods.description: Handles the cleanup after exiting a 'for' node, updating internal loop tracking state.

methods.name: addLoopToCurrent
methods.description: Sets the 'with_loop' attribute to true for the current loop, indicating the loop variable should be included.

methods.name: addLoopToAll
methods.description: Sets the 'with_loop' attribute to true for all active loops, ensuring loop variables are available.

methods.name: getPriority
methods.description: Returns the priority of this visitor, used to determine its execution order relative to other visitors.
